description: <Advisor Belgrum reaches the end of the note, and his eyes widen for a moment.>
<name>, please return to Historian Karnik and tell him on the king's authority to act on this information swiftly and decisively. He must halt the Shadowforge's activities in the Badlands.
completion: You're treating this matter with an urgency I'd expect from the king himself, <name>.
All right, then. I know what'll bring the Shadowforge down.
Their presence in Uldaman can be slowed if we strike them at their base of operations: Angor Fortress.
